overview.name: Ocean Park Diversified Income ETF
overview.description: The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund (“ETF”) that seeks to achieve its investment objective by tactically allocating the fund’s assets between unaffiliated fixed income ETFs and cash equivalents. Under normal market conditions, the advisor expects to invest substantially all of its assets in underlying ETFs.
